AcceleratingDetectRequest.title: AcceleratingDetectRequest
AcceleratingDetectRequest.description:
Accelerating or decelerating call-pattern detection on one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    min_pulses: Minimum pulses in a pattern.

    deceleration: Deceleration threshold, or ``None`` to find only accelerating
        patterns.
    low_freq: Low frequency bound (Hz).
    high_freq: High frequency bound (Hz).
    window: Analysis window (s).
    output: Where to save the detections (``.json`` for JSON, otherwise CSV).

AddRequest.title: AddRequest
AddRequest.description:
Add files or folders to a workspace.

Attributes:
    directory: Where to start looking for the workspace.
    paths: The files or folders.
    kind: Artifact kind (default: guessed).
    name: Display name (only with a single path).

AnalyzeRequest.title: AnalyzeRequest
AnalyzeRequest.description:
Measure the quality of a clustering.

Attributes:
    embeddings_file: The embeddings (``.npy``, 2-D).
    labels_file: The labels (``.npy``, 1-D).
    output: A JSON file to save the analysis to.

AudioAddNoiseRequest.title: AudioAddNoiseRequest
AudioAddNoiseRequest.description:
Add white noise at a target signal-to-noise ratio.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    snr_db: Target SNR (dB; lower is noisier).
    seed: Random seed, for repeatable noise.

AudioConvertRequest.title: AudioConvertRequest
AudioConvertRequest.description:
Convert a file's format, sample rate or channel count.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    sample_rate: Target sample rate (Hz).
    channels: Target channel count (1 or 2; default: keep the file's own).
    bit_depth: Bits per sample (WAV: 8, 16, 24, 32; FLAC: 8, 16, 24); by default the
        source's when the output holds it, else 16.
    format: Output format; by default, from ``output``'s extension.

AudioDenoiseRequest.title: AudioDenoiseRequest
AudioDenoiseRequest.description:
Spectral noise reduction.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    strength: Reduction strength, 0 to 2.

AudioFeaturesRequest.title: AudioFeaturesRequest
AudioFeaturesRequest.description:
Frame-level descriptors and MFCCs of one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the per-frame table (``.csv`` or ``.parquet``).
    config: Analysis settings.
    trajectory: Add the MFCC-PCA timbre trajectory (``pc1``..``pc3``).
    gate_db: Trajectory gate: frames this far below the loudest are left out.

AudioFilterRequest.title: AudioFilterRequest
AudioFilterRequest.description:
Apply one frequency filter to a file (band-pass, else low-pass, else high-pass).

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    lowpass: Low-pass cutoff (Hz).
    highpass: High-pass cutoff (Hz).
    bandpass_low: Band-pass lower edge (Hz).
    bandpass_high: Band-pass upper edge (Hz).
    order: Filter order.

AudioGainRequest.title: AudioGainRequest
AudioGainRequest.description:
Apply a fixed gain.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    gain_db: Gain (dB; positive amplifies).

AudioInfoRequest.title: AudioInfoRequest
AudioInfoRequest.description:
A file's header information.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    metadata: Also read recorder metadata (GUANO, AudioMoth, WAMD, bext).

AudioListRequest.title: AudioListRequest
AudioListRequest.description:
The audio files under a folder.

Attributes:
    path: The folder.
    recursive: Search subfolders.

AudioMetadataRequest.title: AudioMetadataRequest
AudioMetadataRequest.description:
A WAV file's recorder metadata.

Attributes:
    file: The WAV file.

AudioNormalizeRequest.title: AudioNormalizeRequest
AudioNormalizeRequest.description:
Normalize a file's level.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    target_db: Target peak (``peak``) or loudness (``rms``) in dB.
    method: ``peak`` or ``rms``.

AudioPitchShiftRequest.title: AudioPitchShiftRequest
AudioPitchShiftRequest.description:
Shift pitch, keeping duration.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    steps: Semitones (positive raises the pitch).

AudioResampleRequest.title: AudioResampleRequest
AudioResampleRequest.description:
Resample a file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    sample_rate: Target sample rate (Hz).

AudioSegmentRequest.title: AudioSegmentRequest
AudioSegmentRequest.description:
Cut a file into fixed-length clips, ``<prefix>_seg0000.<format>``, ...

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output_dir: The folder to write the clips to.
    duration: Clip length (s).
    overlap: Overlap between clips (s).
    format: Clip format.
    prefix: Clip name prefix (default: the file's name without extension).
    include_partial: Keep the last clip when it is shorter than ``duration``
        (left out by default).

AudioTimeStretchRequest.title: AudioTimeStretchRequest
AudioTimeStretchRequest.description:
Stretch in time, keeping pitch.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    rate: Stretch factor (>1 faster, <1 slower).

AudioTrimRequest.title: AudioTrimRequest
AudioTrimRequest.description:
Keep part of a file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: Where to save the result.
    start: Start time (s).
    end: End time (s); default the end of the file.
    duration: Length (s), instead of ``end``.

AudioVideoRequest.title: AudioVideoRequest
AudioVideoRequest.description:
A spectrogram, waveform or timbre-trajectory video of a file, with its audio.

Spectrogram options (``motion``, ``n_fft``, ``hop_length``, ``n_mels``, ``fmax``,
``db_range``, ``playhead``, ``waveform``) apply to ``mel``, ``stft`` and
``waveform``; ``trail``, ``orbit`` and ``spectrogram`` to ``trajectory``.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: The video file to write.
    viz_type: ``mel``, ``stft``, ``waveform`` or ``trajectory``.
    motion: ``scroll`` (picture moves) or ``page`` (playhead moves).
    start: Start (s).
    end: End (s); default the end of the file.
    fps: Frames per second.
    window: Seconds across the frame (0: the whole recording, page mode); for a
        trajectory, the spectrogram strip's span (must be positive).
    width: Frame width (px).
    height: Frame height (px).
    cmap: Colormap; by default the renderer's (``magma``, or ``plasma`` for a
        trajectory).
    n_fft: FFT window size.
    hop_length: Hop length.
    n_mels: Mel bands.
    fmax: Highest frequency shown (Hz); default Nyquist.
    db_range: Dynamic range (dB).
    playhead: Playhead position across the frame, 0 to 1.
    waveform: Scrolling waveform strip.
    axes: Frequency ticks and time readout.
    include_audio: Mux the audio track.
    trail: Trajectory: fade path older than this many seconds.
    orbit: Trajectory: turn the view slowly.
    spectrogram: Trajectory: mel spectrogram strip along the bottom.

AudioVisualizeRequest.title: AudioVisualizeRequest
AudioVisualizeRequest.description:
A spectrogram, MFCC or waveform image of a file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    output: The image file to write.
    viz_type: ``mel``, ``stft``, ``mfcc`` or ``waveform``.
    n_fft: FFT window size.
    hop_length: Hop length.
    n_mels: Mel bands.
    n_mfcc: MFCCs.
    cmap: Colormap name.
    dpi: Image DPI.
    legend: Show axes, title and colorbar.
    boxes: Regions to outline (seconds, Hz).
    annotations: An annotation file (any format bioamla reads) whose
        annotations are outlined too, labelled.

    recursive: Search subfolders.
    verbose: Log progress.

FrameFeatureConfig.title: FrameFeatureConfig
FrameFeatureConfig.description:
Settings for :func:`frame_features`.

``n_fft``, ``hop`` and ``f_max`` default to values derived from the sample rate:
``n_fft`` 1024 (2048 above 60 kHz), ``hop`` ``n_fft // 4``, and ``f_max`` the
lower of 92% of Nyquist and 16 kHz.

Attributes:
    n_fft: FFT size in samples.
    hop: Samples between frame starts.
    n_mels: Number of mel bands.
    n_mfcc: Number of MFCCs, including c0.
    f_min: Lower edge of the analysis band in Hz.
    f_max: Upper edge of the analysis band in Hz.
    denoise: Subtract the stationary noise floor before measuring.
    noise_percentile: Percentile (0-1) of each bin's magnitude taken as its noise floor.
    noise_scale: Factor applied to that percentile before subtracting.

    annotation_file: The annotation file.
    output: The labels file to write.
    frame_size: Frame length (s).
    hop_length: Step between frames (s); default the frame size.
    audio_duration: The recording's length (s); by default from the file.
    output_format: ``csv`` or ``numpy``.
    recording: For a file covering several recordings: the one to label.

HistoryRequest.title: HistoryRequest
HistoryRequest.description:
A workspace's run history.

Attributes:
    directory: Where to start looking for the workspace.
    limit: The last N runs (``None``: all).
    failed: Only runs that failed.

InatDownloadRequest.title: InatDownloadRequest
InatDownloadRequest.description:
Download iNaturalist observations' sounds.

Attributes:
    output_dir: Where to save them.
    taxon_ids: Taxon IDs.
    taxon_name: Taxon name.
    place_id: Place ID.
    project_id: Project slug or ID.
    quality_grade: ``research``, ``needs_id``, ``casual`` or ``any``.
    licenses: Sound licenses to accept (``cc0``, ``cc-by``, ...).
    start_date: First observation date (YYYY-MM-DD).
    end_date: Last observation date.
    obs_per_taxon: Maximum observations per taxon.

InatSearchRequest.title: InatSearchRequest
InatSearchRequest.description:
iNaturalist observations with sounds.

Attributes:
    species: Scientific name.
    taxon_id: iNaturalist taxon ID.
    place_id: iNaturalist place ID.
    project_id: Project slug or ID.
    quality_grade: ``research``, ``needs_id`` or ``casual``.
    limit: Maximum observations.
    output: A CSV to save them to.

InatStatsRequest.title: InatStatsRequest
InatStatsRequest.description:
An iNaturalist project's statistics.

Attributes:
    project_id: Project slug or ID.
    output: A JSON file to save them to.

IndexBandRequest.title: IndexBandRequest
IndexBandRequest.description:
One frequency-banded index (ACI or BIO) of one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    min_freq: Low-frequency bound (Hz).
    max_freq: High-frequency bound (Hz), or ``None`` for the Nyquist frequency.
    n_fft: FFT window size.

IndexRequest.title: IndexRequest
IndexRequest.description:
An index of one file that only takes the FFT size (entropy).

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    n_fft: FFT window size.

IndexThresholdRequest.title: IndexThresholdRequest
IndexThresholdRequest.description:
One threshold index (ADI or AEI) of one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    db_threshold: dB threshold.
    n_fft: FFT window size.

IndicesComputeRequest.title: IndicesComputeRequest
IndicesComputeRequest.description:
Every acoustic index of one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    n_fft: FFT window size.
    aci_min_freq: ACI low-frequency bound (Hz).
    aci_max_freq: ACI high-frequency bound (Hz), or ``None`` for the Nyquist frequency.
    bio_min_freq: BIO low-frequency bound (Hz).
    bio_max_freq: BIO high-frequency bound (Hz).
    db_threshold: dB threshold for ADI and AEI.
    output: A JSON file to save the indices to.

IndicesTemporalRequest.title: IndicesTemporalRequest
IndicesTemporalRequest.description:
Acoustic indices of one file over consecutive windows.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    window_duration: Window length (s).
    n_fft: FFT window size.
    output: A JSON file to save the segment rows to.

InfoRequest.title: InfoRequest
InfoRequest.description:
An AST model's type, classes and size.

Attributes:
    model_path: The model (Hugging Face ID or local path).

InitConfigRequest.title: InitConfigRequest
InitConfigRequest.description:
A documented training config file to edit.

Attributes:
    output: The file to write.
    force: Overwrite an existing file.

InitRequest.title: InitRequest
InitRequest.description:
Make a folder a workspace.

Attributes:
    directory: The folder.
    name: Workspace name (default: the folder's name).

LicenseRequest.title: LicenseRequest
LicenseRequest.description:
A LICENSE or ATTRIBUTIONS.md from a dataset's metadata.

Attributes:
    path: The dataset folder, or (with ``batch``) a folder of datasets.
    template: A file to put at the top.
    output: The file name.
    format: ``text`` (LICENSE) or ``md`` (ATTRIBUTIONS.md).
    metadata_filename: The metadata CSV's name.
    batch: Every dataset under ``path``.

ListRequest.title: ListRequest
ListRequest.description:
A workspace's artifacts.

Attributes:
    directory: Where to start looking for the workspace.
    kind: Only this kind.

ManifestRequest.title: ManifestRequest
ManifestRequest.description:
A ``dataset.json`` manifest from a dataset's metadata CSV.

Attributes:
    dataset_dir: The dataset folder.
    name: Dataset name (default: the folder's name).
    kind: ``labeled`` or ``partitioned``.
    output: Where to write it (default: ``<dataset_dir>/dataset.json``).
    metadata_filename: The metadata CSV's name.
    sample_rate: Sample rate to record.

MergeRequest.title: MergeRequest
MergeRequest.description:
Merge datasets into one.

Attributes:
    output_dir: The merged dataset's folder.
    dataset_paths: The datasets to merge.
    metadata_filename: Each dataset's metadata CSV name.
    overwrite: Overwrite existing files instead of skipping them.
    organize: Organize files by category (else keep each dataset's layout).
    target_format: Convert all audio to this format.
    verbose: Log progress.

MlDownloadRequest.title: MlDownloadRequest
MlDownloadRequest.description:
Download Macaulay Library recordings (at least one filter).

Attributes:
    output_dir: Where to save them.
    max_recordings: Maximum recordings.

MlSearchRequest.title: MlSearchRequest
MlSearchRequest.description:
Macaulay Library recordings (at least one filter).

Attributes:
    species_code: eBird species code.
    scientific_name: Scientific name.
    common_name: Common name.
    region: Region code (e.g. US-NY).
    country: Country code.
    taxon_code: eBird taxon code.
    hotspot_code: eBird hotspot code.
    min_rating: Minimum rating (1-5).
    max_results: Maximum results.

NdsiRequest.title: NdsiRequest
NdsiRequest.description:
The Normalized Difference Soundscape Index (NDSI) of one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    n_fft: FFT window size.

NearbyRequest.title: NearbyRequest
NearbyRequest.description:
Recent eBird observations near a place.

Attributes:
    lat: Latitude.
    lng: Longitude.
    distance: Search radius (km).
    days: Days back.
    limit: Maximum observations.
    output: A CSV to save them to.

NoveltyRequest.title: NoveltyRequest
NoveltyRequest.description:
Find novel samples among embeddings.

Attributes:
    embeddings_file: The embeddings (``.npy``, 2-D).
    output: Where to save is-novel flags and scores.
    method: ``distance``, ``isolation_forest`` or ``lof``.
    threshold: Novelty threshold.
    labels_file: Known cluster labels (``.npy``, 1-D).

PartitionRequest.title: PartitionRequest
PartitionRequest.description:
Split a dataset into train, validation and test.

Attributes:
    dataset_dir: The dataset folder, or its metadata CSV.
    train: Train fraction.
    val: Validation fraction.
    test: Test fraction.
    seed: Shuffle seed.
    stratify: Balance labels across splits.
    mode: ``subdirs`` (move files into split folders) or ``column``.
    group_by: Keep rows sharing this column's value in one split (``""``: none).
    background_label: Partition this label as its own stratum.
    metadata_filename: The metadata CSV's name.
    verbose: Log progress.

PeaksDetectRequest.title: PeaksDetectRequest
PeaksDetectRequest.description:
CWT peak detection on one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    snr: Signal-to-noise ratio threshold.
    min_distance: Minimum distance between peaks (s).
    low_freq: Low frequency bound (Hz), or ``None`` for no bound.
    high_freq: High frequency bound (Hz), or ``None`` for no bound.
    output: Where to save the peaks (``.json`` for JSON, otherwise CSV).

PredictRequest.title: PredictRequest
PredictRequest.description:
Classify one audio file with an AST model.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    model_path: The model (Hugging Face ID or local path).
    segment_duration: Classify N-second segments (0: the whole file).
    overlap: Overlap between segments (s).
    min_confidence: Leave out predictions below this.
    output: A CSV to save the predictions to.
    resample_freq: The model's sample rate.

PullDatasetRequest.title: PullDatasetRequest
PullDatasetRequest.description:
Pull a Hugging Face audio dataset into label folders and a metadata.csv.

Attributes:
    repo_id: The Hub dataset.
    dest: Where to write it.
    split: One split (default: all).
    config: Dataset config or subset name.
    audio_column: The audio column (default: detected).
    label_column: The label column (default: detected).
    sample_rate: Resample to this rate (0: keep).
    layout: ``both``, ``audiofolder`` or ``flat``.
    verbose: Log progress.

PushDatasetRequest.title: PushDatasetRequest
PushDatasetRequest.description:
Push a dataset folder to the Hugging Face Hub, writing its card first.

Attributes:
    path: The dataset folder.
    repo_id: The Hub repository.
    private: Create it private.
    commit_message: The commit message.
    card: Write a README.md dataset card first.
    coordinates: Per-file locations in what is uploaded: ``keep``, ``round``,
        ``strip``.
    coordinate_decimals: Decimal places ``round`` keeps (0-6).

PushModelRequest.title: PushModelRequest
PushModelRequest.description:
Push a model folder to the Hugging Face Hub.

Attributes:
    path: The model folder.
    repo_id: The Hub repository.
    private: Create it private.
    commit_message: The commit message.

ReduceRequest.title: ReduceRequest
ReduceRequest.description:
Reduce embeddings to fewer dimensions.

Attributes:
    embeddings_file: The embeddings (``.npy``, 2-D).
    output: Where to save the reduced embeddings.
    method: ``pca``, ``umap`` or ``tsne``.
    n_components: Output dimensions.

RemapRequest.title: RemapRequest
RemapRequest.description:
Rename labels with a mapping CSV (``source``, ``target``).

Attributes:
    input: The source file.
    output: The file to write.
    mapping: The mapping CSV.
    keep_unmapped: Keep rows whose label isn't mapped.

RemixRequest.title: RemixRequest
RemixRequest.description:
A derived dataset from a recipe and/or selections.

Attributes:
    output_dir: The new dataset's folder.
    recipe: A TOML recipe.
    source: Source dataset folder (overrides the recipe's).
    keep: Keep only these labels.
    drop: Drop these labels.
    name: Dataset name.
    label_column: The column holding labels.
    template: A file to put at the top of the generated LICENSE.
    metadata_filename: The metadata CSV's name.
    verbose: Log progress.

RemoveRequest.title: RemoveRequest
RemoveRequest.description:
Forget an artifact.

Attributes:
    artifact_id: The artifact.
    directory: Where to start looking for the workspace.
    delete_import: Also delete an imported artifact's copy.

RibbitDetectRequest.title: RibbitDetectRequest
RibbitDetectRequest.description:
RIBBIT periodic-call detection on one file.

Attributes:
    file: The audio file.
    pulse_rate: Expected pulse rate (pulses per second).
    tolerance: Tolerance around the pulse rate, as a fraction.
    low_freq: Low frequency bound (Hz).
    high_freq: High frequency bound (Hz).
    window: Analysis window (s).
    min_score: Minimum detection score.
    output: Where to save the detections (``.json`` for JSON, otherwise CSV).

SchemaRequest.title: SchemaRequest
SchemaRequest.description:
A config's JSON Schema, or (without ``name``) the configs that have one.

Attributes:
    name: The config (see ``configs``).
    output: A file to write the schema to.

SpeciesRequest.title: SpeciesRequest
SpeciesRequest.description:
A species in the eBird taxonomy.

Attributes:
    name: Common name, scientific name or species code.

SpeciesSearchRequest.title: SpeciesSearchRequest
SpeciesSearchRequest.description:
Fuzzy search of the eBird taxonomy.

Attributes:
    query: What to look for.
    limit: Maximum results.

StatsRequest.title: StatsRequest
StatsRequest.description:
Summary statistics of a dataset's metadata CSV.

Attributes:
    dataset_dir: The dataset folder, or its metadata CSV.
    metadata_filename: The metadata CSV's name.

SummaryRequest.title: SummaryRequest
SummaryRequest.description:
Summary statistics of an annotation file.

Attributes:
    file: The annotation file.
    format: Its format; by default from its name or header.

TemplateRequest.title: TemplateRequest
TemplateRequest.description:
A starter annotation file for a recording.

Attributes:
    audio_file: The recording.
    output: The annotation file to write.
    format: Its format; by default from its name.
    label: Label of the placeholder row.
    empty: Write no placeholder row.

TrainRequest.title: TrainRequest
TrainRequest.description:
Fine-tune an AST model.

Attributes:
    train_dataset: A Hugging Face dataset ID, a metadata CSV, or a folder with one
        subfolder per class.
    config_path: A training config file (``models.ast.init-config``).
    training_dir: Where training writes its outputs and the model.
    options: Training options set explicitly; anything else comes from the config
        file, then the defaults (see :data:`bioamla.ml.AST_TRAIN_DEFAULTS`).

UnzipRequest.title: UnzipRequest
UnzipRequest.description:
Extract a ZIP archive.

Attributes:
    file: The archive.
    output_dir: Where to extract it.

ValidateRequest.title: ValidateRequest
ValidateRequest.description:
Is a species expected at a place (recent eBird observations)?

Attributes:
    species_code: eBird species code.
    lat: Latitude.
    lng: Longitude.
    distance: Search radius (km).

VisualizeBox.title: VisualizeBox
VisualizeBox.description:
A region to outline on a picture (see :class:`bioamla.viz.SpectrogramBox`).

Attributes:
    start: Start (s).
    end: End (s).
    low_freq: Lower edge (Hz); leave both edges out for the full height.
    high_freq: Upper edge (Hz).
    label: Text at its top-left corner.

WorkspaceRequest.title: WorkspaceRequest
WorkspaceRequest.description:
A workspace, found from a folder.

Attributes:
    directory: Where to start looking.

XcDownloadRequest.title: XcDownloadRequest
XcDownloadRequest.description:
Download Xeno-canto recordings.

Attributes:
    output_dir: Where to save them.
    species: Species name.
    genus: Genus.
    country: Country.
    quality: Quality filter.
    max_recordings: Maximum recordings.
    delay: Seconds between downloads.

XcSearchRequest.title: XcSearchRequest
XcSearchRequest.description:
Xeno-canto recordings.

Attributes:
    species: Species name.
    genus: Genus.
    country: Country.
    quality: Quality (A-E).
    sound_type: Sound type (song, call, ...).
    max_results: Maximum results.

ZipRequest.title: ZipRequest
ZipRequest.description:
Zip a folder or a file.

Attributes:
    source: The folder or file.
    output: The archive to write.
